cognomen.configuration.title: Cognomen
cognomen.configuration.name: Name
cognomen.configuration.name.tooltip: Used in singleplayer from the next world you open. 1 to 16 characters, no spaces, ASCII only; a name that breaks this plays under a stand-in name. Your account name is never used.
cognomen.toast.unusable.message: "%s" is not a valid player name, so you are playing as "%s".
cognomen.toast.empty.message: No name is set, so you are playing as "%s".
cognomen.multiplayer.title: Multiplayer is off
cognomen.multiplayer.message: While Cognomen is installed, multiplayer and Realms are unavailable: a server has to be told your account name to let you in. Remove the mod to play online.
cognomen.toast.name.title: Cognomen: name not used
cognomen.configuration.skin.tooltip: A 64×64 PNG, as a path from the game folder, for example config/cognomen/skin.png. Leave empty to look like Steve. Used from the next world you open.
cognomen.configuration.slimArms.tooltip: Put the skin on the slim-armed model instead of the wide one.
cognomen.toast.skin.title: Cognomen: skin not used
cognomen.toast.skin.missing: "%s" was not found, so you look like Steve.
cognomen.toast.skin.unreadable: "%s" could not be read as a PNG, so you look like Steve.
cognomen.toast.skin.size: "%s" is %s×%s, but a skin has to be %s×%s, so you look like Steve.
